name: fir_ccf_31tap
description: 31-tap low-pass FIR on complex samples vs fir_filter_ccf

params.taps_note: windowed-sinc low-pass, cutoff 0.1 cycles/sample, Hamming window, DC gain 1

float_vs_gnuradio.rationale: Same float taps on both sides; differences are float32 accumulation order only (measured 0.002 LSB, 144.7 dB).

fixed_vs_float.rationale: Q15 taps (sum of |tap rounding error| = 5.9 LSB per unit input) and rounded output (0.5 LSB per component): per component <= 0.5 + 5.9 * 0.7 LSB (|x| <= 0.7 FS per component). SNR: rounding noise 1/12 LSB^2 plus the tap error acting on 0.125 FS^2 per component -> about 83 dB; minimum is the measured 83.6 dB - 1 dB.
As q15_nearest, but truncation adds up to 1 LSB per component with mean -0.5 LSB; minimum is the measured 81.4 dB - 1 dB.

Q17 taps (sum of |tap rounding error| = 1.41 Q15 LSB per unit input) and 0.125 Q15 LSB output rounding per component. 4x finer steps: about 12 dB over Q15 from rounding alone; minimum is the measured 99.0 dB - 1 dB.
